The picture is `design notes/login flow.png`. It's a simple diagram titled **"Login flow"**: four rounded boxes in a row, joined by purple lines:

```
[ visit ] ── [ sign in ] ── [ two-factor ] ── [ dashboard ]
```

So a user visits, signs in, completes two-factor authentication, and then reaches the dashboard. The picture has no other labels, branches or error paths.

To open the image itself on your Mac, run `open "design notes/login flow.png"`.
